tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.purpose: Return contract version, supported components, modes and feature flags.

tools.name: get_config_schema
tools.purpose: Return the current configuration schema and field annotations.

tools.name: validate_config
tools.purpose: Validate and normalize configuration; return config_digest, a redacted preview, and the effective_config with execution defaults expanded.

tools.name: build_plan
tools.purpose: Create an immutable, expiring execution plan without changing infrastructure.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.purpose: Read a plan, its risks, prerequisites, changes and approval text.

tools.name: preflight_plan
tools.purpose: Verify mounted Docker Secret availability and required TCP reachability for a valid plan without authenticating or changing infrastructure. Node SSH checks are skipped when the plan includes VM creation.

tools.name: get_preflight
tools.purpose: Read a persisted non-mutating preflight result while its associated plan remains valid.

tools.name: render_runbook
tools.purpose: Render an audited, directly executable installation manual from an immutable plan (real versions, endpoints, paths, and commands) and write the audited deliverable to the control host workspace.

tools.name: start_run
tools.purpose: Validate one component-plan approval gate, then queue VM, node-init, Local RKE2, Rancher, or downstream execution on the strict-known-host SSH control host. Rancher requires a successful Local RKE2 component run with the same config digest, and downstream requires a successful Rancher run with the same config digest.

tools.name: start_workflow
tools.purpose: Validate one exact VM-to-node-init, VM-to-Local-RKE2, VM-to-Rancher, or VM-to-downstream workflow approval, create VMs, wait for every node TCP/22 readiness, initialize nodes, install the three-server Local RKE2 cluster when selected, install Rancher when selected (reusing the same run's Local RKE2 kubeconfig), and create/register the downstream custom cluster when selected (reusing the same run's Rancher private-CA artifact). When deliverables.installation_manual is true it also renders and audits the reference deployment manual. Stops on failure and never retries automatically.

tools.name: get_run
tools.purpose: Read a persisted approval-gated run state.

tools.name: get_run_events
tools.purpose: Read structured, redacted run events incrementally.

tools.name: collect_diagnostics
tools.purpose: Collect fixed, bounded, credential-redacted runtime evidence from the declared control host without changing infrastructure. Depth is summary, standard, or deep.

planned_tools.name: resume_run
planned_tools.purpose: Resume the same run from its persisted checkpoint.

planned_tools.name: retry_component
planned_tools.purpose: Retry one failed or blocked component after dependency checks.

planned_tools.name: cancel_run
planned_tools.purpose: Request a safe cancellation at the next supported checkpoint.

planned_tools.name: render_runbook
planned_tools.purpose: Render an audited human-executable installation manual from a plan.

planned_tools.name: destroy_vm_set
planned_tools.purpose: Destroy only the complete VM set managed by the selected run's Terraform State.
